system.description: Your eye reads the load-bearing lines before they fail — a shift in the aether-current through the stratum, a hairline in the keystone, the smell of wet clay under a dry floor. You are immune to environmental hazards from unstable ground (collapse, tremors, sinking foundations). Spend (SL × 5) MP to extend this protection to up to (SL) allies until the end of the scene.
